name: Wrapiglet
look: a round pink piglet wrapped snugly in a golden crescent roll of dough, its head poking out of the top
entry: It wraps itself in a soft blanket of dough as soon as it hatches and naps in it the whole day long. The dough bakes golden in the sun, and it smells so good that Pokémon follow it around.
how: Wild: common in plains and grasslands, uncommon in villages.
